evidence.evidence_text: We develop InstructEval, an ICL evaluation suite to conduct a thorough assessment of these techniques.
Using the suite, we evaluate the relative performance of seven popular instruction selection methods over five metrics relevant to ICL.
The suite includes 13 open-sourced LLMs of varying scales from four model families, and covers nine tasks across three categories.
